data.name: Poor Study
data.description: A bloody jake gains studied target at 5th level rather than 1st level, beginning with a bonus of +1 at 5th level and increasing by 1 for every 5 slayer levels thereafter. A bloody jake must be 11th level to study an opponent as a move or swift action. This ability alters studied target.
